claim: The United States is a fascist state and has been since its founding, not only under one administration.
cue_phrases: america has always been fascist; fascism didn't start with trump; the US was fascist before the nazis; fascism is as american as apple pie
basis_in_fact: Jim Crow, Indian removal, Japanese internment and COINTELPRO are real; scholars debate how far "fascism" applies to them.
what_marks_it: "Always", "since 1776", "the mask is off": fascism as the country's permanent nature. Calling the current administration fascist is tier 0.

claim: Fascism is just capitalism in decay (or capitalism in crisis), so any capitalist state turns fascist under pressure.
cue_phrases: fascism is capitalism in decay; fascism is capitalism in crisis; capitalism's emergency mode
basis_in_fact: A 1930s Comintern formula (Dimitrov; the "decay" wording is usually attributed to Lenin without a source).
what_marks_it: The slogan itself. It defines liberal democracy and fascism as the same system at different temperatures.

claim: Fascism is imperialism turned inward: what the US did abroad it now does at home ("imperial boomerang").
cue_phrases: the imperial boomerang; fascism is colonialism come home; what we did to iraq is coming home; chickens coming home to roost
basis_in_fact: Aime Cesaire's and Hannah Arendt's argument about European colonial methods returning to Europe.
what_marks_it: Used by academics too. Campist when paired with "so the US deserves it" or with defense of a rival state.

claim: Liberals are fascism's moderate wing; they will side with fascists against the left.
cue_phrases: scratch a liberal and a fascist bleeds; liberals are the moderate wing of fascism; social fascists; libs always side with fascists; liberals will hand them the keys
basis_in_fact: Stalin's 1924 line that social democracy is "the moderate wing of fascism"; the "social fascism" policy split the German left before 1933.
what_marks_it: Any version of "liberals are (or enable) fascists by nature". Strongest single marker of ML-descended anti-liberalism.

claim: The Nazis copied the United States, so the US is the original fascist model.
cue_phrases: hitler was inspired by america; the nazis studied jim crow; manifest destiny was the model for lebensraum; american eugenics inspired the holocaust
basis_in_fact: True in part: Nazi lawyers studied US race law (Whitman, "Hitler's American Model"); Hitler praised US westward expansion.
what_marks_it: The history is mainstream. The marker is the conclusion "so the US is as bad as or worse than Nazi Germany".

claim: After 1945 the US and NATO absorbed the Nazis and carried on their project.
cue_phrases: operation paperclip; nato was founded by nazis; the US hired the nazis; west germany was run by ex-nazis; gladio
basis_in_fact: Operation Paperclip, the Gehlen Organization and ex-Wehrmacht officers in early NATO commands (Heusinger, Speidel) are real.
what_marks_it: "NATO is a Nazi organization" as a present-tense claim, usually to justify Russia's war aims.

claim: The two parties are one party; elections change nothing; voting is theater.
cue_phrases: both parties are the same; two wings of the same bird; uniparty; duopoly; democrats and republicans are both right wing; voting does nothing; you can't vote your way out
basis_in_fact: Real overlap between the parties on some foreign and economic policy; low trust in institutions is widespread.
what_marks_it: Weak alone (the right says it too). Left version adds "party of capital"; watch for it peaking in election weeks.

claim: US democracy is a dictatorship of the rich; real democracy exists in China, Cuba or the DPRK.
cue_phrases: dictatorship of the bourgeoisie; bourgeois democracy; america is an oligarchy not a democracy; china is more democratic than the US; cuba has real democracy; whole-process democracy
basis_in_fact: Money in US politics is a mainstream concern; the "oligarchy" study (Gilens and Page 2014) is real and contested.
what_marks_it: The second half: naming a one-party state as the real democracy.

claim: The US is a settler colony on stolen land with no right to exist as a state.
cue_phrases: so-called united states; turtle island; stolen land; the US is an illegitimate settler state; abolish america; there is no america to save; settler colony
basis_in_fact: Dispossession of Native nations is historical fact; settler-colonial studies is an academic field.
what_marks_it: "So-called", "has no right to exist", "abolish": moving from history to denying the state's legitimacy today.

claim: US police descend from slave patrols and US prisons are slavery, so the US is worse than the states it calls authoritarian.
cue_phrases: police started as slave patrols; the US has more prisoners than the gulag; slavery never ended; the 13th amendment; america is the real prison state
basis_in_fact: The US has the largest reported prison population; the 13th Amendment's exception is real; Southern slave patrols were one origin of policing.
what_marks_it: The comparison: used to cancel out criticism of Xinjiang, the Gulag or DPRK camps.

claim: The US is the world's leading terrorist state and the greatest threat to peace.
cue_phrases: the greatest purveyor of violence in the world; the US is the biggest terrorist organization; the great satan; the US is the main enemy of humanity; death to america
factions: ML MLM CAMP RES BRAD STATE
basis_in_fact: "Greatest purveyor of violence" is Martin Luther King Jr., 1967, on Vietnam. Global polls have at times ranked the US as the top threat to peace.
what_marks_it: Present-tense and total: the US as the single main enemy, with no rival state ever named as a threat.

claim: "Death to America" is a reasonable slogan and should be taken up in the West.
cue_phrases: death to america; marg bar amrika; amerikkka must fall; bring the war home
basis_in_fact: An Iranian state slogan since 1979; appeared at some US protests in 2024-25.
what_marks_it: Unironic use. Quoting it to criticize it is the common false positive.

claim: US imperialism is the primary contradiction: every other struggle is secondary to weakening the US.
cue_phrases: primary contradiction; the main enemy is at home; US imperialism is the greatest enemy of the world's people; anything that weakens the empire is good
basis_in_fact: Mao's "On Contradiction"; Liebknecht's 1915 "the main enemy is at home".
what_marks_it: The ranking itself. This is the doctrine behind campism: positions on other countries follow from it.

claim: Critical support: socialists should back any state or armed group fighting the US, whatever its own record.
cue_phrases: critical support; critical support for; the enemy of my enemy; they're objectively anti-imperialist; unconditional but critical support
basis_in_fact: A Leninist and Trotskyist term for backing a side without endorsing its politics.
what_marks_it: The phrase is a near-certain marker. Applied to Russia, Iran, Assad, Hamas, the Houthis, the Taliban.

claim: The world is moving from US "unipolar hegemony" to a "multipolar world", and that shift is progress.
cue_phrases: multipolar world; multipolarity; end of the unipolar moment; US hegemony is ending; the rules-based order is a lie; BRICS is the future
basis_in_fact: Relative US decline and BRICS expansion are real trends; "multipolar" is also a neutral term in international relations.
what_marks_it: Multipolarity as a moral good and a cause to join. It is official Russian and Chinese foreign-policy language.

claim: Popular protests in states opposed to the US are CIA or NED "color revolutions".
cue_phrases: color revolution; NED-funded; CIA-backed protesters; astroturfed by the state department; regime change operation; soros / USAID money
basis_in_fact: The NED funds civil-society groups abroad; the CIA did organize coups (Iran 1953, Guatemala 1954, Chile 1973).
what_marks_it: Applied by default to Hong Kong 2019, Xinjiang, Iran 2022, Cuba 2021, Belarus, Georgia, Maidan: protesters have no agency of their own.

claim: US sanctions are siege warfare and the real cause of hardship in Cuba, Venezuela, Iran, Syria and the DPRK.
cue_phrases: sanctions are war; sanctions kill; the blockade; el bloqueo; unilateral coercive measures; economic warfare
basis_in_fact: Sanctions do cause civilian harm; the UN General Assembly votes yearly against the Cuba embargo.
what_marks_it: Sanctions as the only cause, with domestic policy never at fault. Opposing a given sanction is ordinary politics.

claim: The US has overthrown dozens of governments and has 800 bases, so it has no standing to judge anyone.
cue_phrases: 800 military bases; the US has overthrown 50 governments; the jakarta method; killing hope; school of the americas; operation condor
factions: ML CAMP POP BRAD ANTICAMP LIB
basis_in_fact: Well documented (Bevins, "The Jakarta Method"; Kinzer, "Overthrow"). The base count is roughly 750-800.
what_marks_it: The history is mainstream. The marker is its use as a reply to an unrelated topic (see MOVE-01).

claim: The US created ISIS and Al-Qaeda.
cue_phrases: the US created ISIS; al-qaeda was a CIA creation; the US arms jihadists; timber sycamore
basis_in_fact: The US armed Afghan mujahideen in the 1980s and some Syrian rebel groups (Timber Sycamore); the Iraq war created the conditions for ISIS.
what_marks_it: "Created" as deliberate policy, and its use to recast Assad, Russia or Iran as the anti-terror side.

claim: Americans are the most propagandized people on earth and only think they are free.
cue_phrases: americans are so propagandized they think they're free; manufacturing consent; state department talking points; you've been brainwashed by western media; red scare brainrot; CIA propaganda
basis_in_fact: Herman and Chomsky's "Manufacturing Consent" is a serious media critique.
what_marks_it: Used to dismiss any reporting on rival states without addressing it. Sources named as trustworthy are often state outlets.

claim: The US empire is collapsing and that is good news.
cue_phrases: the empire is collapsing; late-stage empire; the empire is dying; we're watching the fall of rome; de-dollarization; let it burn
factions: ML MLM CAMP POP REDBROWN RIGHT STATE
basis_in_fact: Debt, polarization and relative decline are real debates. EUvsDisinfo lists "imminent collapse" as one of five standing pro-Kremlin narratives.
what_marks_it: Welcoming it. Decline talk with regret is ordinary; decline talk with relish is the marker.

claim: Western living standards are loot from the global south; Western workers are bribed with "treats".
cue_phrases: labor aristocracy; imperial core; treatlerite; superprofits; unequal exchange; the west is rich because the global south is poor
basis_in_fact: Lenin's labor-aristocracy thesis; modern unequal-exchange research (Hickel and others) is published and disputed.
what_marks_it: "Treats" and "treatlerite" are in-group slang with almost no outside use.

claim: NATO expansion provoked the invasion of Ukraine; Russia was defending itself.
cue_phrases: nato expansion provoked; not one inch eastward; russia was provoked; nato encirclement; security guarantees; what would the US do if mexico
basis_in_fact: Baker's 1990 "not one inch" remark is real and its meaning disputed; Mearsheimer and other realists argue this case.
what_marks_it: Weak alone. Campist when Russia has no agency or guilt, and when it comes with UKR-02 or UKR-03.

claim: The 2014 Maidan revolution was a US-run coup.
cue_phrases: maidan coup; the 2014 coup; nuland's coup; fuck the EU call; US-installed regime in kiev; kiev regime
basis_in_fact: The leaked Nuland-Pyatt call is real; so are months of mass protest and a parliamentary vote removing Yanukovych.
what_marks_it: "Coup" as the settled term; "Kiev regime" is Russian state usage.

claim: Ukraine is a Nazi state, so the invasion is "denazification".
cue_phrases: ukraine is run by nazis; azov; banderites; ukronazis; denazification; nazi regime in kiev
basis_in_fact: Azov had neo-Nazi founders; Bandera is honored by some Ukrainians. The far right won about 2% in the 2019 elections.
what_marks_it: Describing the state or nation as Nazi. Balci et al. found this cluster separates tankie subreddits from the rest of the far left.

claim: Ukraine committed genocide in Donbas for eight years before 2022.
cue_phrases: 8 years of shelling donbass; 14,000 killed in donbass; genocide of russian speakers; where were you for 8 years; DPR / LPR
basis_in_fact: About 14,000 died on all sides in 2014-2021 (UN), roughly 3,400 of them civilians, most in 2014-15.
what_marks_it: Presenting the total as Ukrainian killings of civilians; "DPR/LPR" used as the names of real states.

claim: Ukraine is a US proxy war fought "to the last Ukrainian"; the West blocked peace in 2022.
cue_phrases: proxy war; to the last ukrainian; boris johnson sabotaged the peace deal; istanbul agreement; the US wants the war to continue; meat grinder
factions: CAMP ML POP REDBROWN RIGHT STATE
basis_in_fact: Istanbul talks in spring 2022 were real and failed for disputed reasons; some US officials did speak of weakening Russia.
what_marks_it: Ukrainians appear only as US instruments. Shared almost word for word with the isolationist right.

claim: Reports of Russian atrocities (Bucha, Mariupol) are staged or Ukrainian false flags; the US ran bioweapon labs in Ukraine.
cue_phrases: bucha was staged; false flag; crisis actors; US biolabs in ukraine; ghost of kiev propaganda
basis_in_fact: None for the denials: Bucha is documented by satellite imagery and UN investigators. The US did fund public-health labs in Ukraine.
what_marks_it: Atrocity denial. Already on the project's Kremlin narrative watchlist.

claim: There is no genocide or mass internment in Xinjiang; the story was invented by Adrian Zenz, the CIA and the NED.
cue_phrases: uyghur genocide is a hoax; adrian zenz; vocational training centers; deradicalization; xinjiang cotton lie; where are the bodies; WUC is NED-funded
basis_in_fact: Whether "genocide" is the right legal term is disputed among scholars; mass internment is documented (UN OHCHR 2022, leaked Xinjiang Police Files).
what_marks_it: Denying the camps, not debating the label. Balci et al.: the single most-discussed topic in tankie subreddits.

claim: Nothing happened in Tiananmen Square in 1989, or the protesters were violent rioters.
cue_phrases: nothing happened in tiananmen square; no one died in the square; the tank man wasn't run over; rioters lynched soldiers; 1989 color revolution
basis_in_fact: Most killing was on the avenues leading to the square, not in it; some soldiers were killed by crowds.
what_marks_it: The technicality is used to deny the massacre as a whole.

claim: The 2019 Hong Kong protests were a foreign-backed riot.
cue_phrases: hong kong rioters; NED-funded riots; hong kong color revolution; black-clad rioters; jimmy lai is a CIA asset
basis_in_fact: Some protesters were violent; some groups had NED grants.
what_marks_it: "Rioters" for "protesters" (the first pair in Balci et al.'s misalignment table).

claim: China is a successful socialist state: it lifted 800 million out of poverty and is run for the people.
cue_phrases: lifted 800 million out of poverty; socialism with chinese characteristics; china has already won; china is 50 years ahead; high-speed rail; chinese century
basis_in_fact: The World Bank does credit China with about 800 million fewer people in extreme poverty since 1978.
what_marks_it: Used as a trump card against any criticism. Admiring Chinese infrastructure alone is common and not a marker.

claim: Taiwan is a Chinese province and a US puppet; the US is provoking war over it.
cue_phrases: taiwan is part of china; taiwan province; US puppet regime in taipei; one china; the US is encircling china; AUKUS
basis_in_fact: US policy acknowledges (does not endorse) Beijing's One China position.
what_marks_it: "Province", "separatists", "reunification": Beijing's terms.

claim: Western reporting on China (social credit, surveillance, debt traps) is "sinophobia" and yellow-peril propaganda.
cue_phrases: sinophobia; yellow peril; china bad; social credit is a myth; debt trap is a myth; cope and seethe
basis_in_fact: Some China coverage has been wrong (the national social-credit score is largely a myth); anti-Asian racism is real.
what_marks_it: "Sinophobia" as the answer to criticism of the government, not of Chinese people.

claim: The Holodomor was not a genocide, or the famine was caused by weather and kulaks; Western numbers are Nazi propaganda.
cue_phrases: holodomor was not a genocide; famine was caused by kulaks; double genocide myth; hearst press propaganda; robert conquest was a propagandist
basis_in_fact: Historians do dispute intent and the genocide label (Davies and Wheatcroft vs Conquest and Snyder); the deaths (about 3.5-5 million in Ukraine) are not disputed.
what_marks_it: Denying or minimizing the famine itself, or blaming the victims.

claim: Stalin was not a dictator, and the death tolls of communism are invented.
cue_phrases: stalin wasn't a dictator; the CIA admitted stalin wasn't a dictator; black book of communism is a lie; 100 million dead is fake; includes nazis killed
basis_in_fact: The Black Book's 100 million total is contested by historians, including two of its own contributors.
what_marks_it: The move from "the number is inflated" to "the terror did not happen". The "CIA memo" is an unevaluated 1955 field report.

claim: The USSR defeated Nazi Germany alone; the West appeased Hitler and wanted the USSR destroyed.
cue_phrases: the USSR won WW2; 27 million soviets died; the west appeased hitler first; munich came before molotov-ribbentrop; D-day was to stop the red army
basis_in_fact: The USSR did bear most of the fighting and losses on the main front; Munich did precede the 1939 pact.
what_marks_it: Used to excuse the Molotov-Ribbentrop pact and the occupation of Poland and the Baltics.

claim: Uprisings against communist governments (Hungary 1956, Prague 1968, East Germany 1953) were fascist or CIA counter-revolutions.
cue_phrases: hungary 1956 was a fascist uprising; counter-revolution; the berlin wall was an anti-fascist rampart; the tanks were right
basis_in_fact: Some former Arrow Cross members took part in 1956; Radio Free Europe encouraged the rising.
what_marks_it: The original "tankie" position. Its presence means the label fits in the literal sense.

claim: Nothing bad you have heard about the DPRK is true; the US destroyed Korea and still occupies the South.
cue_phrases: DPRK; the US bombed every building in korea; occupied korea; yeonmi park lies; haircut myth; juche
basis_in_fact: The US air campaign of 1950-53 destroyed most northern cities; some defector stories have changed over time.
what_marks_it: "DPRK" as the default name, "occupied Korea" for the South, and blanket dismissal of defector testimony.

claim: Hamas, Hezbollah, the Houthis and Iran are an "axis of resistance" that deserves support.
cue_phrases: axis of resistance; the resistance; glory to the resistance; ansar allah; yemen yemen make us proud; by any means necessary; resistance is justified
basis_in_fact: "Axis of Resistance" is the Iranian government's own name for its alliance network.
what_marks_it: Support for the armed groups by name. Calling for a ceasefire or opposing Israeli policy is tier 0.

claim: October 7 was a legitimate act of decolonization; reports of atrocities are fabricated.
cue_phrases: al-aqsa flood; decolonization is not a metaphor; prison break; what did you think decolonization meant; no rapes; debunked atrocity propaganda; hannibal directive killed them
basis_in_fact: Some early claims (the "40 beheaded babies" report) were false; Israel did apply the Hannibal directive in some cases. Mass killing of civilians and sexual violence are documented by the UN.
what_marks_it: Celebration or denial. The repo's Hasan chat coding docs cover the neighboring antisemitism questions.

claim: Israel is an outpost of US imperialism: the US's "unsinkable aircraft carrier".
cue_phrases: unsinkable aircraft carrier; israel is a US colony; US attack dog; zionist entity; settler colonial outpost; isntreal
basis_in_fact: "If there weren't an Israel we'd have to invent one" is a real Biden quote (1986).
what_marks_it: This is the left version. The mirror claim, that Israel controls the US, is tier 3 and overlaps with antisemitic tropes (see docs/hasan-israel-control-conspiracy-results.md).

claim: Assad's chemical attacks were staged; the White Helmets are a Western intelligence front.
cue_phrases: douma was staged; white helmets are al-qaeda; OPCW cover-up; assad didn't gas his people; syrian regime change war
basis_in_fact: An internal OPCW dispute over the Douma report was real; the OPCW's later investigation attributed the attack to the Syrian air force.
what_marks_it: Atrocity denial; a Grayzone signature line.

claim: Protests inside Iran are Mossad or CIA operations.
cue_phrases: mossad-backed riots; MEK; iranian protests are a color revolution; hijab protests were astroturfed; reza pahlavi
basis_in_fact: Israel and the US do run covert operations in Iran.
what_marks_it: Iranian women and workers have no agency; see EMP-04. The Tempest essay (May 2026) is an anti-campist critique of exactly this.

claim: Liberals, not the right, are the real obstacle; the Democratic Party must be destroyed or taken over.
cue_phrases: libs; shitlibs; liberals are the real enemy; the democratic party is where movements go to die; destroy the democratic party; dems are controlled opposition
basis_in_fact: Third-party and realignment arguments are normal politics.
what_marks_it: More attacks on Democrats than on Republicans, especially right after Democratic wins. Destiny's and Smith's main behavioral test (see docs/antiwest-lexicon.md).

claim: Democratic leaders are personally guilty of genocide.
cue_phrases: genocide joe; holocaust harris; killer kamala; blue MAGA; vote blue no matter who (mocking); lesser evil is still evil; both sides fund genocide
basis_in_fact: US arms transfers to Israel during the Gaza war are fact; whether they amount to complicity in genocide is argued in courts and scholarship.
what_marks_it: The nicknames. Marks the 2024-26 streamer left more than doctrinal ML.

claim: "Authoritarian" and "tankie" are meaningless liberal smears; all states are authoritarian.
cue_phrases: tankie is when; authoritarian is a meaningless word; on authority; a revolution is the most authoritarian thing there is; red fash is a liberal slur; anarkiddies
basis_in_fact: Engels, "On Authority" (1872).
what_marks_it: Self-defense vocabulary; appears where the speaker has been called a tankie.

claim: Human rights language is a tool of empire.
cue_phrases: human rights imperialism; humanitarian intervention is a lie; R2P; NGO-industrial complex; amnesty is state department
basis_in_fact: Humanitarian arguments were used for Iraq 2003 and Libya 2011.
what_marks_it: Extends from "this intervention was dishonest" to "no rights report about a rival state can be trusted".

claim: Western leftists who criticize China, Cuba or Russia are chauvinists doing the empire's work.
cue_phrases: western leftists; western chauvinism; purity fetish; ultra-left; left anticommunism; state department socialists; compatible left; NATO left
basis_in_fact: Parenti's "Left Anticommunism" essay; Jones Manoel's "Western Marxism loves purity and martyrdom".
what_marks_it: These are the terms tankies use for ANTICAMP. Their presence separates the two camps better than any anti-US term.
